{{Lunisolar January}} 
'''January 1''' is the 1st day of month {{ill|Zhengyue|cdo|Nùng-lĭk 1 nguŏk|gan|正月|hak|Nùng-la̍k 1-ngie̍t|ja|1月 (旧暦)|ko|음력 1월|simple|Mutsuki|th|เดือนอ้าย|vi|Tháng giêng|wuu|正月|za|Ndwencieng|zh|正月|zh_min_nan|Kū-le̍k 1 goe̍h|zh_yue|正月|qid=Q1072983|lt=January (Mutsuki)}}  the 1st month of the traditional {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|simple|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|qid=Q11511066}} . It's {{ill|Rokuyō|et|Rokuyō|ja|六曜|zh|六曜|qid=Q9418169}}  day is {{ill|senshū|qid=Q96759839}}{{efn|ja|先勝|1=Rokuyō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q9418169}}{{efn|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 六曜|1=Rokuyō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q9418169}} .
